# Vulture

> > Vulture is New York Magazine's entertainment coverage site featuring TV recaps, movie rankings, celebrity news, and cultural criticism across streaming platforms like Netflix, Hulu, HBO, and Bravo reality television.

Vulture provides comprehensive entertainment journalism including episode-by-episode reality TV recaps (Below Deck Down Under, RuPaul's Drag Race, Bridgerton), film criticism and rankings, breaking celebrity news, streaming guides, and in-depth interviews with filmmakers and creators. The site covers major studios and networks including Paramount, HBO, Bravo, and streaming services.

## Key Topics

- Reality TV recaps
- Below Deck Down Under
- Bravo programming
- HBO series coverage
- Netflix originals
- Streaming guides
- Celebrity news and controversy
- Film rankings and criticism
- Oscar season coverage
- Paramount releases
- RuPaul's Drag Race
- Bridgerton recaps
- Weekend viewing recommendations
- Hollywood industry news
